text:
katie: quick q — I'm opening a terraform PR that renames the service port from `https` -> `app-tls`. PR: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/pull/312. Will that break NLB/ALB SNI/default-cert healthchecks? 
ajay: if you're just renaming `name:` field in k8s service, ALB/Ingress rules that match port names could stop matching. For NLB passthrough we care about nodePort/targetPort mapping. 
sam: TL;DR: don't change the `port.name` used by Gateway API/Ingress route matchers. If we need a new port label, add a new port instead of renaming. 
katie: ok — this is coming from a module change where ports are generated from tf var `service_ports`. Wanted to avoid adding another port. Any quick mitigation? 
leo: add a `portNameOverride` to the module or set `service.spec.ports[].targetPort` explicitly to keep numeric mapping stable. Also ensure `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol` annotations if ALB expects HTTP/HTTPS. 
ajay: also check secretBinding for Gateway AGW — if SNI fallback uses `default-certificate` mapping it looks for the `tls`/`https` port name sometimes. If that changes, the gateway may not pick fallback cert. 
katie: ah — that's exactly my worry. Our gateway has annotation `gateway.networking.k8s.io/default-certificate: apps/default-cert`. If port name changes, does the binding break? 
sam: I've seen it. On our env the Gateway implementation looked up `listener.name` matching service port name. If it doesn't match, listener still exists but won't route correctly. We changed module to set `name = "https"` explicitly for the existing listener and added `name = "app-tls"` for new one. 
infra-bot: deploy-bot: plan for infra/service-module PR #312 — diff contains: `- name: "https"` `+ name: "app-tls"` — initiating review reminder. 
leo: For a quick canary, keep existing port as-is and add the new port. Then update Ingress/Gateway/Route to reference the new port in a progressive rollout. 
katie: thanks — I'll rework the PR to add a port instead of renaming and add a module flag for `preserve_port_name`. tagging @ajay @sam for quick 👀 on the PR. 
ajay: sg, will look this afternoon. If you want me to run a cluster smoke test for TLS handshake + healthchecks, ping me. 
katie: ping when PR is up — thx :thumbsup:
